rca of the issue: Iter 7's residual dup-key warnings were caused by DashboardPage.js using `<Link key={stat.link}>` inside `statsCards.map((stat, index) => ...)`. statsCards had 4 entries sharing 2 link paths: 'رصيد محفظة الزبون' & 'إجمالي الزبائن' both → /customers, and 'رصيد محفظة المستخدم' & 'ديون محفظة المستخدم' both → /wallet-management. React's reconciliation correctly flagged the colliding keys. The single-line fix at line 176 (key now `stat-${index}-${stat.link}`) makes each key unique by index. Verified live: navigating dashboard → wallet-mgmt → customers → sales → pos → dashboard produces 0 dup-key warnings (down from 2).
